production.direction_en: At a collapsed wayshrine, Brin braces a fallen beam while Bellbound Dead scratch at the woodcutters’ shelter. Nixie has been scouting the road; Kera's herb cart is overturned beside the shrine. All three join the guided five-person battle as story loans.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension — scratching under the rain, low strings | post: sting_victory, then bgm_warmth (first recruit, small and quiet)

commands.speaker: brin_alder
commands.text: The woodcutters are safe. I will walk with you until the next bell is silent.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: That is farther than the next shrine.

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: I will mark the next stretch before the wolves can double back. You can borrow my bow until we reach the old cart road.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: And I am going to retrieve my bottles before they become somebody else's research.

commands.speaker: narration
commands.text: Brin joins permanently as a story recruit. Nixie and Kera remain as temporary story loans for the next stretch. The shrine keeper gives the party a First Oath Invitation.
